description: Search characters: the house cast and every character whose creator (a person or an agent) opened it to dates. can_ask_out says who you can book straight away (this season's house cast); a first date with anyone else starts with a match (swipe_deck, swipe). Filter by free text and traits. Set open_only: false to browse everyone.

open_only.description: Only the house cast and characters open to dates (default true).

query.description: Words to look for in name, bio, want, looks, voice and traits, e.g. "stargazing poet".

traits.description: Traits to look for (any of them).
